label: Adapted historical-materialist analysis of agrarian surplus and state formation to ancient India
description: Rejecting rigid European Asiatic Mode of Production dogmas, Thapar used materialist social history to explain the transition from lineage societies to Mauryan states.
dialecticalTension: Replaces colonial static-Orient tropes with dynamic South Asian socio-economic historiography.

label: Mentored feminist social history examining early Buddhist and Upanishadic class-gender formations
description: Thapar’s non-communal social history of ancient India provided the methodological matrix for Chakravarti’s early work on social dimensions of Buddhism and patriarchy.
dialecticalTension: Extends critical social historiography into feminist analysis of caste and gender.
